title: Customer engagement in B2B sales - the future is agentic
excerpt: How the B2B sales process has transformed in recent years
content_html:
The B2B sales process has transformed in recent years, spurred on by agentic AI developments.

These always-on systems identify sales cues and act in real-time, alongside automating orchestration and timely cross-business interactions, reducing latency.

Intelligent, critical thinking-led AI debriefs are also helping sales representatives capture customer insight.

Managing Partner & CEO of Oraczen.

In this model, AI underpins a hyper personalized, efficient and timely B2B sales experience which ensures every customer interaction is captured, understood and acted on.

The sales process: why traditional feels transactional

Business-to-business (B2B) sales experience looks and feels dated in this era of hyper personalized consumer selling. Sales representatives continue to record information within CRM platforms after any customer or prospect interaction, but this traditional method means that depth of information is limited to customer names, key dates, completed sales and other basic details.

This process ends up lacking the depth of the human touch and judgement, meaning the result is transactional and functional, and not always successful.

On top of this, deals take months to close, requiring input from multiple decision-makers and internal stakeholders. Sales representatives have to rely on memory and interpretation of previous interactions and also spend hours updating the wider business teams, coordinating activity and chasing for vital updates.

Often, elements of the customer experience, such as delays in delivery or incomplete orders, which directly influence the current relationship and future sales, are often not communicated down the line.

Agentic AI is changing this. Instead of relying on fragmented information and manual coordination, agentic AI presents businesses with an intelligence-led model that supports faster, more informed customer engagement.

How agentic AI is switching on customer engagement

To truly succeed in B2B sales, there must be effective collaboration throughout the business to allow rapid recognition of buying signals and swift, personalized responses. Agentic AI is switched on, constantly monitoring for these signals by tracking product usage, highlighting billing friction, checking email sentiment and, critically, prioritizing these events and orchestrating the response.

By creating quotes, sending updates to colleagues and generating prompts to help B2B revenue teams engage more effectively, agentic AI also plays a critical role in transforming productivity. By automating these tasks, representatives are free to focus on providing a more personalized customer experience, alongside improving the overall timeliness of decision-making and enhancing engagement and outcomes.

The technology can also initiate routine debriefs. Automating this after every sales visit enables the seamless capture of nuance, human judgement and subtle sales cues, for example: colleagues who may influence the decision, customer business issues that will impact the timeline or a billing dispute. All of this information would have likely been missed previously.

The agentic AI also then drives action forward, for example, triggering a pre-brief ahead of the renewal call and creating a customer-ready response and automatic update of the sales forecast in the case of a billing dispute.

It’s time to transform sales performance

Clearly, agentic AI has the potential to completely transform sales performance, capturing and contextualizing every customer interaction and empowering representatives to be more productive and successful. To achieve this, data from across the business must be structured, enriched and pulled together so that it can detect signals, prompt the correct actions and allow the business to make smarter, more timely decisions.

However, technology and the right data alone isn’t enough to ensure success. In fact, recent research has highlighted that agentic AI projects have a high failure rate, with over 40% expected to be cancelled by the end of 2027. But what is the cause for this?

To create a successful agentic AI tool, it requires complex, ground-up builds that take a significant length of time to deliver, challenging the desired Return on Investment. Instead, many organizations are now turning towards pre-built, subscription-based systems, which are changing this by offering rapid deployment and measurable impact within quarters.

As sales cycles become longer and buying committees become larger, the ability to identify signals, coordinate responses and surface insight in real time becomes increasingly valuable. This value isn’t replacing humans, but rather removing the friction that prevents representatives from selling effectively.

By combining human judgement with automated signal detection, orchestration and insight, agentic AI becomes a foundation for a responsive, personalized and truly successful B2B customer experience.

销售流程：为什么传统的方式给人一种交易的感觉

在这个超个性化消费者销售时代，企业对企业 (B2B) 销售体验看起来和感觉都已经过时了。 在与客户或潜在客户互动后，销售代表会继续在 CRM 平台中记录信息，但这种传统方法意味着信息的深度仅限于客户姓名、关键日期、已完成的销售和其他基本详细信息。

这个过程最终缺乏深度的人情味和判断力，这意味着结果是事务性的和功能性的，并且并不总是成功的。

除此之外，交易需要数月时间才能完成，需要多个决策者和内部利益相关者的意见。 销售代表必须依靠记忆和对之前互动的解释，并花费数小时更新更广泛的业务团队、协调活动并寻找重要的更新。

通常，直接影响当前关系和未来销售的客户体验要素（例如交货延迟或订单不完整）通常不会被直接传达。

代理人工智能正在改变这一点。 代理人工智能不依赖碎片化信息和手动协调，而是为企业提供了一种以智能为主导的模型，支持更快、更明智的客户参与。

代理人工智能如何提高客户参与度

要在 B2B 销售中真正取得成功，整个企业必须进行有效的协作，以便快速识别购买信号并做出快速、个性化的响应。 Agentic AI 已开启，通过跟踪产品使用情况、突出计费摩擦、检查电子邮件情绪，以及最重要的是，确定这些事件的优先级并协调响应，不断监控这些信号。

通过创建报价、向同事发送更新以及生成提示来帮助 B2B 收入团队更有效地参与，代理 AI 在提高生产力方面也发挥着关键作用。 通过自动化这些任务，代表可以专注于提供更加个性化的客户体验，同时提高决策的整体及时性并增强参与度和成果。

该技术还可以启动例行汇报。 在每次销售拜访后自动执行此操作，可以无缝捕获细微差别、人为判断和微妙的销售线索，例如：可能影响决策的同事、将影响时间表的客户业务问题或计费纠纷。 所有这些信息以前可能都会被遗漏。

然后，代理人工智能还会推动行动向前推进，例如，在续订电话之前触发预简报，并在出现计费争议时创建客户就绪响应并自动更新销售预测。

是时候改变销售业绩了

显然，代理人工智能有潜力彻底改变销售业绩，捕捉每一次客户互动并将其情境化，并帮助代表提高工作效率和成功率。 为了实现这一目标，必须对来自整个企业的数据进行结构化、丰富和整合，以便能够检测信号、提示正确的行动并允许企业做出更明智、更及时的决策。

然而，仅靠技术和正确的数据并不足以确保成功。 事实上，最近的研究强调，代理人工智能项目的失败率很高，预计到 2027 年底，超过 40% 的项目将被取消。 但这是什么原因呢？

要创建成功的代理人工智能工具，需要复杂的、从头开始的构建，需要很长的时间才能交付，这对期望的投资回报构成了挑战。 相反，许多组织现在正在转向预构建的、基于订阅的系统，这些系统通过在几个季度内提供快速部署和可衡量的影响来改变这一现状。

随着销售周期变得更长和购买委员会变得更大，识别信号、协调响应和实时洞察的能力变得越来越有价值。 这种价值并不是取代人类，而是消除阻碍代表有效销售的摩擦。

通过将人类判断与自动信号检测、编排和洞察相结合，代理 AI 成为响应式、个性化和真正成功的 B2B 客户体验的基础。
